text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that standing be prohibited from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on the west side of Shaver Avenue South, between Dundas Street West and 70 metres north. The proposed amendment will help address, through enforcement, concerns regarding trucks parking on this portion of road despite the existing posted parking regulations and impeding traffic flow.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited standing from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on the west side of Shaver Avenue South, between Dundas Street West and 70 metres north.
